description: Look up TLS cipher suites by IANA name, OpenSSL name, GnuTLS name or hex code (0x13,0x01 / 0xC02F) — one or a whole list from a scanner, server config or ClientHello — and get key exchange, authentication, cipher, MAC / PRF hash, AEAD and forward-secrecy flags, minimum protocol, the IANA Recommended flag (Y / N / Discouraged) and a security rating (recommended, secure, weak, insecure) with reasons: no forward secrecy, CBC, SHA-1, RC4, 3DES, EXPORT, NULL or anonymous. Lists get a summary and their worst suite. Without a suite, browse the 356-entry IANA registry filtered by protocol or rating. Offline data: IANA registry, OpenSSL 3.6 and GnuTLS names. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cipher-suite-info

suite.description: One or more suites (names or hex), separated by spaces, colons, commas or newlines
